action.objective: Verify Rxf4, capturing the loose f4 pawn and winning material with rook activity in a trivially winning endgame.
action.rationale: Broad search shows Rxf4 as the top move with exact depth-4 score 1723, well above alternatives; PV f8f4 g7g6 f4e4 g6h6 wins the f4 pawn. Capturing is clearly best: the pawn falls, the rook activates to e4. No Black mate threats apparent with only king and pawn. Verify this single candidate for safety and to reach commit-ready.
